questions.question: Which access modifier makes an attribute only accessible within its own class?
explanations: protected allows access in subclasses and the same package.
Correct. private restricts access only to the same class.
default allows access within the same package.

questions.question: What is a getter?
options: A method that modifies an attribute
A method that returns the value of an attribute
explanations: Correct. A getter is a public method that returns the value of a private attribute.
It has nothing to do with constructors.
A getter is a method, not an attribute.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using setters with validation?
options: The attribute can be accessed from outside
The integrity of the object's data is protected
explanations: The length of the code is not the main advantage.
That is what getters do, not setters.
Correct. Setters allow validation before modifying, protecting the state.
